summary.shortDescription: A revision-specific iJoy 20700 five-leg rewrap rated at 3000mAh and 30A continuous.
summary.description: The exact five-leg revision has 3000mAh and 30A test support. Four-leg and later cells used the same wrap, so physical five-leg identification is required.
highlights: Do not merge later same-wrap revisions

sources.title: IJOY 20700 3000mAh High Drain 5 Leg
sources.limitations: Retail evidence identifies the five-leg vape-battery revision.

sources.title: iJoy 40A 3000mAh 20700 Bench Test Results
sources.limitations: Exact five-leg test; four-leg and later revisions using the same wrap are materially different.

safetyFindings.summary: Physical five-leg marking is required; later same-wrap cells are separate identities.
